articles.summary: Modern Treasury’s PSP now supports physical and digital checks through one API alongside ACH, wires, RTP, FedNow, push-to-card, and stablecoins. With built-in ledgering and AML controls, businesses can launch faster, cut operational overhead, and reconcile every payment in one place.
articles.title: Modern Treasury Adds Physical and Digital Check Payments to Its Unified Payments API

articles.summary: Developers using Modern Treasury's PSP can now send instant, 24/7/365 payouts to U.S. debit cards over Visa Direct and Mastercard Send with a new developer experience built to get them live faster.
articles.title: Modern Treasury’s Payment Service Provider Launches a New Developer Experience for Instant Push-to-Card Payouts
